page.description: Assign a shift or day off per person per day. Drafts are also used by punching (late/early) and shift-based payroll; "Publish" only controls whether employees can see them. For days without a schedule, fixed-schedule employees follow the default shift and calendar.
page.legendHint: Amber outline = unpublished draft; hover a cell for details
page.draftHint: Click a cell to set that day's shift or day off. Weekends and calendar holidays are shaded. For shift schedules, rest days, mandatory days off and national holidays are all shifted — put them on the actual day off.

cell.choose: Choose the shift or day-off type for this day

shiftTypes.title: Shift Types
shiftTypes.description: Define each shift's start and end times and break. An end time earlier than the start time means an overnight shift.
shiftTypes.name: Shift name
shiftTypes.crossHint: Break time is not counted as working time, which is used by the working-hours alerts. A shift used by a schedule cannot be deleted; deactivate it instead.

quickFill.title: Quick Fill Schedule
quickFill.description: Pick employees and a date range to fill the same shift or day-off type in one go (or clear).
quickFill.choose: Choose a shift or day-off type

publish.title: Publish the {{month}} schedule?
publish.body: {{count}} draft cell(s) are not yet published. Once published, employees can see them in their portal. Later edits to published cells are reflected for employees too.
